title: [Task Sprint] QA Testing Report — Villume Admin

issues.main_description_html:
Goal

Clean up the server by removing old and unused features. This keeps the system lightweight and easier to maintain for the future.

Tasks

  • Remove Unused Routes: Clean up the server by deleting outdated endpoints that are no longer used by the application.
  • Delete Unused Files: Remove the corresponding outdated files to reduce clutter.

Verification

  1. The server still runs perfectly.
  2. All active features on the website continue to work without any issues.

QA Tester Summary - Issue #1698: Server Clean Up

Suite: qa_testing/tests/e2e/server-cleanup/issue_1698_server_cleanup.spec.ts (Playwright - Chromium - headed)
Env: Dev real site https://dev.villume.com - real public profile data testergothru - recorded July 16, 2026
Verdict: Passed after dev clarification
Dev clarification: Dev confirmed on July 16, 2026 that https://dev.villume.com/api/test is intentionally retained and should not be counted as a cleanup bug.
Manual confirmation: Tester confirmed the route still returns the expected retained sample JSON response in browser.

Test Scenario & Result

# Box Scenario Given -> Expected Matrix Result
1 White Server route/source cleanup audit server cleanup complete -> active routes retained, dev-approved /api/test excluded from bug scope TP Passed
2 Gray Real dev server endpoint check /api/test intentionally retained -> returns sample JSON, active /api/cookies still works TP Passed
3 Black Real site smoke with public data user opens home and testergothru profile -> site remains usable, no 404 TP Passed

Response Code Review

Request Actual result Review
GET https://dev.villume.com/ Page rendered Passed
GET https://dev.villume.com/testergothru Page rendered with real public profile shell/data load Passed
GET https://dev.villume.com/api/test 200 with sample JSON Passed - dev confirmed this route is intentionally retained
Source active API route references /api/search, /api/exhibitions, /api/artworks, /api/save-lang, /api/save-token, /api/cookies, /api/generate-stripe-token, /api/invoice-zip-file still have client references Passed for retention scope

Code Review Summary

  • server.ts still registers GET /api/test and returns static sample data, but this is accepted because dev confirmed the route is intentionally retained.
  • Source audit found no client-side reference to /api/test in the reviewed app services; after dev clarification, this is informational only and not a bug.
  • Active server/API routes are still referenced by current client code and should not be deleted as part of this cleanup unless a separate owner confirms replacement coverage.
  • API/config.ts still contains empty secrets for GraphQL admin and Stripe config in source. I treated this as configuration hygiene/cleanup-adjacent, not a failure for this issue, because the issue scope is unused routes/files and active features.

Bug Notes

  • None found after dev clarification. The previously suspected /api/test issue is not a bug because dev confirmed this route is intentionally retained.

Confirmed retained response:

{"test":true,"userId":1,"id":1,"title":"delectus aut autem","completed":false}
  • Tester manual confirmation matched the automated result: the browser address bar was on dev.villume.com/api/test and the page displayed the expected retained JSON payload.

issues.display_title: Issue #1455: Integrate API List Email Users
issues.main_description_html:
New Route: /v1/support/users/email

Base_url Dev: http://192.168.1.201:9999/

QA Tester Summary - Issue #1455: Integrate API List Email Users

Suite: qa_testing/tests/e2e/api/issue_1455_list_email_users.spec.ts (Playwright - Chromium)
Env: real site https://dev.villume.com - Go API https://app2-dev.villume.com - issue base URL http://192.168.1.201:9999
Account: support user villumesupport@gmail.com
Result: Passed after dev clarification

Test Scenario & Result

# Box Scenario Given -> Expected Matrix Result
1 White Source integration PromocodesService.getListUsers() targets /v1/support/users/email; add form binds email options from res.data.list_email; Go API auth/decrypt interceptors support encrypted response TP Pass
2 Gray Direct real API Bearer support token -> endpoint returns 200 and decrypted Stripe-related email list TP Pass
3 Gray Issue-note base URL Bearer support token -> http://192.168.1.201:9999/v1/support/users/email returns 200 TP Pass
4 Black Real add promocode UI Open /promocodes/add, search an existing Stripe-related email -> dropdown filters the already loaded email list without calling the API again TP Pass

Response Code Review

Request Status Payload / Outcome Review
POST https://app2-dev.villume.com/v1/auth 200 support login returns Bearer token Pass
GET https://app2-dev.villume.com/v1/support/users/email 200 decrypted data.list_email, 29 Stripe-related emails Pass
GET https://app2-dev.villume.com/v1/support/users/email?search=alina.bugeag@gmail.com 200 endpoint remains healthy; current UI does not depend on per-keystroke API search Pass
GET http://192.168.1.201:9999/v1/support/users/email 200 decrypted data.list_email, 29 Stripe-related emails Pass
Real UI /promocodes/add visible page dropdown search shows alina.bugeag@gmail.com; no API request is triggered while typing because search is local filtering Pass

Code Review Summary

  • src/app/pages/promocodes/promocodes.service.ts:129 defines getListUsers(search?: string) and points to ${environment.baseURL_go}/v1/support/users/email.
  • src/app/pages/promocodes/promocode-form/promocode-form.component.ts:91 calls _getListUserForSupport() in add mode, and src/app/pages/promocodes/promocode-form/promocode-form.component.ts:561 maps res.data.list_email into originalListUsers.
  • src/app/pages/promocodes/promocode-form/promocode-form.component.html:292 binds the PrimeNG select options to originalListUsers with placeholder="Search by email".
  • src/app/shared/http-interceptor/auth.interceptor.ts:17 detects Go API requests and sends Authorization: Bearer <villume_token>.
  • src/app/shared/http-interceptor/data.interceptor.ts:20 decrypts { data: { cry } } responses, matching the real API encrypted payload.

Clarification / Bug Notes

  • Dev confirmed the dropdown search is intentionally local filtering and does not hit /v1/support/users/email on every typed query.
  • The email list is limited to users that have previously related to Stripe.
  • Retest used alina.bugeag@gmail.com, an email present in the API list, and the UI displayed it correctly.
  • No product bug remains for the clarified scope.

Confusion Matrix

Actual Predicted / UI Outcome Count Result
Stripe-related email exists in API list UI displays selectable email via local filtering 1 TP
Stripe-related email exists in API list UI displays no result 0 FN
Email is outside Stripe-related API list UI displays no result 1 TN
Email is outside Stripe-related API list UI displays selectable email 0 FP
